card.name: Inside dose tables and numbers
card.fires_on: Numbers, units and repeated terms inside dense dosing or results tables, where a value or unit is about to repeat or continue. Examples are digits within a number, mg or lb after a figure, and ALT in a lab list.

modes.label: Digits within numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a multi-digit figure or percentage in a table or interaction list.

modes.label: Units and repeated terms
modes.description: A unit or repeated dosing word in a table row that repeats the same pattern.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of crowded dose and results tables, on numbers and units that are still mid-entry.
